title: Drift Off Tonight 🌙 1 Min 432Hz Sleep Music
description:
Settle in and breathe. "Celestial Drift" blends warm ambient pads tuned to 432Hz, soft piano, a slow drift through starlight, and a subtle theta-wave binaural undertone to guide you into deep calm.

Perfect for:
🧘 Meditation & breathwork
😴 Stress relief and deep relaxation
📖 Quiet focus, reading, or journaling
🌙 Winding down before sleep

What you're hearing:
• Ambient pads in 432Hz tuning — warm, slowly evolving harmonies
• Soft piano — sparse, gentle melodies
• A slow drift through starlight
• Theta binaural undertone — headphones recommended for the full effect

Find a comfortable position, breathe slowly, and let the sound carry you.
